title: OAuth lifecycle settings
description: Union of the jwt-bearer, oauth-client-credentials and oauth-token-exchange settings. Lifecycle validation does not require an endpoint or a selected style; binding does. Credentials are lent separately. An absent blob is equivalent to {}.

token_url.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

token_uri.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

scope.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

subject.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

resource.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

subject_token_type.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

max_response_bytes.description: Token response byte limit; null also selects the default.
